newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsumi shares up on good profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Mitsumi shares up on good profit forecast.

text.p: Shares of Mitsumi Electric Co Ltd rose in active trade on Tuesday afternoon, traders said.

Mitsumi shares were popular following the company's announcement on Monday that it would post group profits in the six months to March 31, 1997, against group losses in the eight months to September 30, 1996, traders said.
Nomura Research Institute Ltd earlier on Tuesday maintained its "1" rating for Mitsumi and that also helped push up the company's share price, they said.
Mitsumi shares were up 170 yen at 2,150 at 0515 GMT.
